verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows jo can be self-hosted. The docs describe a vendor-provisioned, per-user isolated cloud machine (Fly) plus a macOS app, which is a managed hosting model. A local client app and a public OpenAPI spec are adjacent features, not a way for users to run the core product on their own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
